problem_statement: Given a string s, determine whether s reads the same forward and backward (a palindrome). Comparison is case-sensitive unless a problem variant explicitly states otherwise.
input_assumptions: s is a Python str (Unicode code points compared in order)
For this benchmark family, empty string is treated as a palindrome
expected_output_summary: Return True if s is a palindrome, else False.
boundary_cases: Non-palindrome with shared prefix/suffix (e.g. aba vs abba)

provenance.author: phase13_authoring_packet
provenance.notes: Authored from standard palindrome definition for human review. Not derived from faulty student mutations or generator pass/fail outcomes.
